coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: PKN Frontage Open Space (20th Street)
record.summary: The roughly half-acre '20th Street Plaza' of the D4D open-space network (Section 3.10), the landscaped entry plaza on Parcel K North's 20th Street frontage at Illinois Street, designed as the gateway from Dogpatch to the Historic Core with an entry plaza, seating terrace and planted garden. The Port's Parcel K North project lists a 20th St/Illinois St plaza among the buyer's obligations; it has not been built.

notes.accuracy_caveat: LOW-MODERATE CONFIDENCE -- Figure 3.3.1 is an illustrative, non-dimensioned rendering (no scale-accurate internal boundaries, unlike the D4D's own numbered-parcel figures), so this is a simplified bounding-box trace, not a precise outline. No specific proper name was found for this feature in the D4D text found so far (unlike Irish Hill Remnant, Waterfront Terrace, Slipways Commons, and the Waterfront Promenade, which are each the subject of their own named, detailed sub-figure elsewhere in the document) -- treat this name as a neutral, location-based placeholder pending a better source, not a confirmed D4D name. Its south/east/west edges match PKN's newly-retraced boundary (see digitization_method); its north edge is now ground-truthed against the real 20th St centerline (6.8m curb offset) rather than Figure 3.3.1's own illustrative depth, which turned out to extend past the real street entirely. Resulting strip is real but thin (~305 sq m) -- narrower than the diagram's own illustrative rendering implies.
notes.digitized_from: Pier 70 Design for Development, Figure 3.3.1 - Illustrative Open Space Plan (p.51).
notes.why_no_real_parcel: Open space with no subdivided Assessor parcel of its own within Brookfield's largely unaddressed 28-acre site.
notes.regulatory_context: Part of the Pier 70 D4D's Open Space Network (Section 3), shown on Figure 3.3.1 as landscaped open space along Parcel K North's 20th Street frontage. No further detail (name, area, specific program) found in the D4D text located so far.

facts.value: 3.10 '20th Street Plaza', zone 6 of the eight public open spaces in Figure 3.4.1

Entry plaza at 20th and Illinois (with interpretive signage and wayfinding, possibly a cafe along 20th Street), seating terrace and planted garden; illustrative section shows about 85 ft of entry plaza, a 51 ft planted garden and a 75 ft seating terrace between Illinois and Michigan Streets
'simple and not detract from the presence of Buildings 101 and 113-116'
Parcel K North buyer (TMG Partners / Presidio Bay Ventures) per the Port's project description of a 20th St/Illinois St plaza and Michigan Street improvements
CFD special taxes from Parcel K North and the Hoedown Yard were projected in 2017 to fund maintenance of open space and streets north of 20th Street

open_questions: This project's geometry file records the zone as an unnamed 'PKN frontage open space'; the D4D names it the 20th Street Plaza (Section 3.10, Figure 3.10.1). Worth updating the geometry file's regulatory_context (not done here per the brief).

Whether the 'Plaza Parcel' created in 2017 was conveyed with Parcel K North or retained by the Port, and who will build the plaza if the PKN building stays unbuilt, is not stated in the retrieved documents.

No basis for an expected-completion date was found: this plaza is delivered by the Parcel K North buyer, whose own building has no target date (see the Parcel K North record's open questions), and no separate schedule for the plaza itself was found, so this record stays undated.
